# Stray Book — Nobody

A reference file left at the library root instead of under `references/`.
Present so the validator's migration error stays covered by a test.

## Mental Model (read first)
Files in the wrong place are unreachable no matter how good they are.

## Frameworks & Structure
### Section 1: Placement
- **Core idea**: the router's link and the file's location have to agree.

## Key Takeaways
1. Put reference files under `references/`.
